SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
S. 2, Special Branch. No. D 6781.
REPORT
Date June 15. 1935.
Subject Arrival of J.V. Gaidul, Soviet Citizen.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. [Signature] 99

Joseph V. GAIDUL, Soviet citizen, arrived in
Shanghai from Moscow via Vladivostock on June 12, 1935, in the
s.s. "SEVER". He holds Soviet passport No.189710 issued
on February 2, 1935, at Moscow. According to him he will
be attached to the local branch of the Moscow Narodny Bank.
Gaidul is accompanied by his wife, Mrs. Irene V.
Gaidul, 35, and their daughter, 6 years of age.
Their address in Shanghai has not yet been located.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).
